baseline.comparison: Night mAP50-95 is 33% below overall; night-pedestrian mAP50-95 is 67% below overall.
baseline.lede: Nighttime pedestrian detection has the lowest mAP50-95 among the evaluated slices.
baseline.metric_definition: mAP50-95: mean Average Precision averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95; higher is better. Slices evaluated: overall, day, night, clear, rain, night pedestrians.

design.goal: Goal: determine whether failure-targeted data selection improves the diagnosed nighttime-pedestrian slice under a fixed training budget.

rows.engine: Failure rate, image similarity, graph communities, night floor
rows.label: Selection signals

example.caption: Night validation frame; ground-truth and detection boxes drawn for the selected model.
example.caveat: One hand-approved frame, shown for illustration; the metric is the aggregate in section 06. The 0.135 claim is below the 0.40 hit floor; the matching rule still counts it as a hit.

intervention.fairness: All intervention arms use the same detector, the same 8,535-image budget (the baseline's 7,035 images plus 1,500 added), the same training configuration, and the same held-out evaluation split.
intervention.headline: 1,500 targeted frames added across 368 scenes.

mining.event_caption: Top-ranked match: scene-1084, 0.45g braking, 12 pedestrians within 10 m (closest 6.2 m), night. Ground-truth boxes drawn.
mining.lede: We search for failure-related scenarios using object proximity, time of day, and vehicle telemetry.

results.example_caveat: One hand-approved frame (illustrative, not the metric).
limitations: Weak labels (negative result): with VLM-verified pseudo labels in place of ground truth, the same selection kept 39.4% of its overall mAP50-95 gain, and that weak-label arm posted the worst night result of the 13 arms (-0.0262).

Evaluation split: acquisition ranks baseline failures on the same 6,019-frame validation split used for evaluation. No validation frame enters training, but the selection signal is not independent of the evaluation set; a separate test split would give an unbiased estimate.
results.overall_note: Overall mAP50-95: 0.2477 → 0.2731 (+0.0254). The best overall arm is `graph` (+0.0344); the targeted arm trades some overall gain for night gain.

selection.lede: The acquisition function targets the diagnosed night weakness: it ranks baseline validation frames by failure rate, routes the top 1,000 to their 10 most similar training-pool frames, splits the 1,500-frame budget across 97 similarity-graph communities in proportion to that failure mass, and fills a 375-frame night floor first.
